name: Rowboat
description: Builds a backlinked knowledge graph from your email, meetings and Slack in a local desktop app, then lets agents query it as a persistent work memory.

skills.name: Backlinked Knowledge Graph
skills.description: Links people, projects and documents across sources into a graph agents traverse to answer questions with context.

skills.name: Work Source Sync
skills.description: Ingests email, calendar, meetings and Slack into local storage so the graph reflects current work automatically.

skills.name: MCP Extensibility
skills.description: Connects MCP servers to extend the coworker with new tools and data sources beyond the built-in integrations.
